title: Try the hull-breach calculator
blurb: Hole a rotor wall and set the size. One square metre takes 27 days to lose 1 percent of the air.

title: Read why Concordia is safer than the 1970s designs
blurb: No windows, a shield that stands still, four sealed cities. What the 1970s cylinders got wrong and what changed.

title: Fly the hang glider
blurb: Take a small electric glider over the city and feel the same wing carry more weight with the spin than against it.

title: Follow the asteroid bag hauler
blurb: Metal-rich asteroids, bagged whole and hauled to L5. See where the station's first metal came from.
